t1.text: YouTube Intelligence v2 — end state inside Finradar (top nav: Daily briefing · Intelligence ▾ · Research ▾ · Settings; YouTube intelligence under Intelligence, with its own side panel)

n1.text: Trust ladder on every call: Text-checked (deterministic checks + critic), Audio-agreed (captions and audio transcript agree on the cited span, anchor within 2s), Human-verified (named reviewer signed). Creator conviction is always a separate chip and never merged with trust.

n2.text: Side panel inside the YouTube intelligence page: Today, Channels, Leaderboard, Saved calls, Lab, Settings. Finradar's own top navigation stays untouched. Nothing shown is imported: every figure is computed from stored rows, and every column heading has a hover that states the definition and calculation steps.

n3.text: Per-account choices: benchmark (SPY default; QQQ, IWM, sector ETF, custom, none), sentiment comparison period (7 vs prior 7 default; 14, 30), default horizon. Team-wide: channels, budget, trust thresholds, providers.
